models.description: Inspect models, convert legacy weights, and export model packages or ONNX files.
models.form.title: Choose operation
models.form.description: Run one model operation; results are recorded in the current project.
models.description.inspect: Select a standard model package or training checkpoint directory to inspect model information and compatibility.
models.description.import: Convert .pth or .pth.tar weights into a standard model package. Place LICENSES.json beside the source file.
models.description.package: Export a standard model package from a training checkpoint. Place LICENSES.json beside the checkpoint directory.
models.description.onnx: Export one ONNX file from a standard model package using fixed opset 17. Training checkpoints must be packaged first.
models.description.features: Advanced tool: convert float32 .npy data shaped [video frames, 2, 1024] into versioned feature files while preserving the original data.
models.source.model: Model package or training checkpoint directory
models.destination.parent_hint: Choose an existing parent directory; a new model package folder will be created inside it.
models.destination.file_hint: Choose a new output file path; existing files are protected.
models.kind.label: Model type
models.kind.import_hint: Legacy import currently supports FeatherHuBERT and Original U-Net.
models.kind.onnx_hint: Choose the type matching the contents of the model package.
models.project_hint: Tasks and logs are saved to the current project.
models.error.no_source: Choose a source file or model directory before submitting this operation.
models.error.no_destination: Choose an output location before submitting this operation.
models.error.source_absolute: Use the file picker to choose the complete source path again.
models.error.destination_absolute: Please choose the complete output path again.
models.error.same_path: Choose a different output location; it cannot be the same as the source path.
models.error.destination_inside_source: Save the output outside the source model directory to preserve the source model's complete directory structure.
models.error.destination_name: Choose a specific new directory or file; the disk root cannot be used.
models.error.unsupported_kind: This model type cannot be imported from legacy weights; choose FeatherHuBERT or Original U-Net.
models.error.legacy_extension: Choose a legacy weights file with a .pth or .pth.tar extension.
models.error.features_extension: Choose a legacy features file with a lowercase .npy extension.
models.error.source_unavailable: Cannot read the source path. Confirm it still exists and check permissions.
models.error.source_file: This operation requires a regular file; choose a source file again.
models.error.source_directory: This operation requires an actual model directory; choose a folder again.
models.error.destination_exists: The output location already exists. Choose a different output location and try again.
models.error.destination_unavailable: The output location cannot be accessed. Check the path and permissions.
models.error.destination_parent: The output location's parent must be an existing directory. Choose another location.

models.result.empty: No model tasks yet. Submit an operation to see progress and results here.
